_comment: Switch to YOLO with {"detector": "yolo", "weights": "best.pt"}. Raise min_fill or lower ball_px if real balls are being rejected as blobs.
_ball_set: english switches the colour model to red/yellow/black/white and turns off stripe detection, which is both simpler and more reliable than the 7-hue American model.
_ball_px: Left unset on purpose: a ball's size in the warped view is worked out from table.json's ball_radius, so the two cannot disagree. Set ball_px here only to override that.
